correctness.rationale: Every labelled matched pair has one of nine types (a,b). Since a vertex excludes at most its paired opposite neighbor, capping each type count at two retains exactly the blink-neighbor decision, producing a deterministic 3^9-state quotient. Occupied-type support cannot increase, so on a recurrent capped orbit the type map permutes surviving types; full labelled first periodic entry agrees with quotient first recurrence and full period follows by the induced permutation order. Independently reimplemented and exhaustively traversed ALL 19683 capped states: eventual periods 3 for 19209, 4 for 449, 18 for 24, empty fixed for 1; max entry 13, maximal feasible n=3,4 cutoff 9. Independently derived and exactly matched the full period-four polynomial P4(z,y) and its expansion with y=e^z-1-z, giving B4(n) for every n. Directly independently enumerated all 729 Cr3 labelled states (period basins 585 and 144, 72 recurrent 18-cycle states, four 18-cycles) and all 6561 Cr4 states (four-cycle basin 1248, max transient nine). These finite exhaustive quotient and formal identities, plus support-permutation lemma, support all n, not just small-n experiments.
